_说明: viewer3d.html?model=amc_facility 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。只画外观：有围墙的机构院落（门岗、执法分队驻点、行政中心、中央工坊、缓冲街道），不画内部。周边棚户、支撑柱、中层底面（bg_*）只在成图里。

title.zh: 资产管理委员会下层设施

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 行政中心：六层办公楼，竖向遮阳鳍板与入口雨棚；委员会在下层的公共设施管理中心。
desc.en: Admin centre: a six-storey office block with vertical fins and an entrance canopy, the committee's lower-tier management centre.

desc.zh: 中央工坊：无窗长厂房，屋顶通风，南侧装卸月台；东南为后勤场院。
desc.en: Central works: a long windowless hall with roof vents and a south loading dock; service yard to the southeast.

desc.zh: 高围墙：外侧墙灯与摄像杆，整圈照明。
desc.en: Perimeter wall: outward wall lights and camera poles, lit all round.

desc.zh: 车辆门岗：岗亭、道闸、车底查验板与雨棚，出入经此登记。
desc.en: Vehicle gate: gatehouse, barrier arms, an under-vehicle inspection plate and a canopy; the controlled entrance.

desc.zh: 执法分队驻点：营房与车棚；委员会直管设施周边有执法分队驻守。
desc.en: Enforcement squad post: barracks and carport; an enforcement squad is stationed around the committee's facility.

desc.zh: 深色巡逻悬浮车、巡逻车与货运卡车（无标识）。
desc.en: Dark patrol hover vehicles, patrol vans and freight trucks (unmarked).

desc.zh: 投光灯塔与路灯：下层少见的明亮区域。
desc.en: Floodlight masts and street lamps: a rare brightly lit area in the lower tier.

desc.zh: 墙外一圈整洁明亮的道路与人行道——下层唯一相对安全的一带，铁皮屋从这里之外开始。
desc.en: A tidy, lit ring road and pavement around the wall: the only relatively safe strip in the lower tier; the shacks begin beyond it.
